§6WHERE THE POWER LEAVES§r
The output manifold BACK FACE, and nothing else. Nothing is ever built behind it at any tier, so every socket on it looks out at open sky - three courses of four, plus the control column.

[img height=400]btsquests:textures/gui/manifold-face.png[/img]

§5§lDO THIS§r
Put four §9Dynamo Hatches (IV)§r into the four D sockets and run cable off them. Put four §9Energy Hatches (IV)§r into the four E sockets one course above.

  §9EU/t = L/t x spine speed x efficiency x (RPM / 500) x average rotor factor§r

§6WHY ENERGY HATCHES ON A GENERATOR§r
§9They are never a STRUCTURE demand.§r The reactor, the spine, the chamber and the gallery consume nothing - no draw, no idle cost, no start-up cost - so leaving all four E sockets empty can never un-form the plant or stop the campaign, and while any are missing the OUTPUT group prints one grey line counting them.

§cTHEY ARE NOT FURNITURE, THOUGH. TWO MODULES RUN ON THEM.§r
Two of the optional modules on the bottom row draw their power through these four sockets and from nowhere else:
  §9Extraction Derrick§r §21,920 EU/t§r while it drills
  §9Enrichment Annex§r §2480 EU/t§r while it enriches
§cBuild either one with no Energy Hatch fitted - or with one fitted and nothing wired into it - and that module silently never turns over.§r So fit at least one §9Energy Hatch (IV)§r here and run a live cable INTO it: your base grid, or straight off one of the Dynamo Hatches in the row below. Both modules running at once is §22,400 EU/t§r, which a single IV hatch carries on its own.
§8The panel backs this up: with a module standing and no hatch, that grey line turns RED and names the Derrick and the Annex.§r

§cThe DYNAMOS are the ones that matter.§r Until a Dynamo or a Laser Source sits in that face, everything the turbine makes is thrown away - and the panel says so in as many words: §6Weakest term:§r §2output ceiling 0 (0%)§r §8- fit Dynamo or Laser Source Hatches in the manifold's back face - nothing can leave§r.

§c§lTHE TRAP§r
Output is clamped to the SUMMED capacity of the dynamo row and the laser row. Four IV dynamos alone are §c32,768 EU/t§r - on a tier-5 build that is 0.003% of what the plant is actually making, and the rest is simply thrown away. The panel prints §cCLAMPED from§r when that is happening, and "Break the Clamp" fixes it.

§2§lDONE WHEN§r
Four Dynamo Hatches (IV) and four Energy Hatches (IV) are in your inventory together. §8Step 8 paid you the four Energy Hatches.§r
§8This quest only LOOKS at what you are carrying, and it takes nothing. Hold the whole set at once, CLAIM it, and only then break the casings and set the machines into the wall. Already installed them? Wrench them back out for a moment - the check is on your inventory, not on the building.§r

§5§lCHECK YOUR WORK§r
The OUTPUT group reads §2Generating§r with EU/t leaving, your cables are live, and the grey Energy Hatch line has gone.

[warn]A multiblock handed more EU than its hatches can take DETONATES in GregTech. The controller clamps before it emits, which is exactly why an undersized output row costs you output instead of your base.[/warn]
